title: Paired d subshell
statement:
Which of these free transition-metal ions has no unpaired electrons in its ground-state configuration?

[_]{a}

explanations: The isolated 3d⁸ ion has unpaired electrons.
The isolated 3d⁵ ion has five unpaired electrons.
The isolated 3d³ ion has three unpaired electrons.

hints: Find a filled or empty d subshell.
solution: Remove the 4s electrons first. Find a filled or empty d subshell. Check actual electron counts. Its 3d¹⁰ subshell is full.
